WITH sku_agg AS ( -- 预聚合 SKU 价格，并过滤已删除和已下架的 SKU SELECT spu_id, MIN(price) as min_price, MAX(price) as max_price FROM sku WHERE deleted_flag = 0 AND status = 1 GROUP BY spu_id ), groupon_agg AS ( -- 预聚合拼团信息 (直接利用 spu_id 关联)，并过滤未生效的拼团 SELECT spu_id, MIN(group_price) as min_group_price, 1 as has_groupon FROM groupon_define WHERE status = 1 GROUP BY spu_id ) SELECT s.id, s.title, s.main_image AS mainImage, s.sales, sku_agg.min_price AS minPrice, sku_agg.max_price AS maxPrice, groupon_agg.min_group_price AS groupPrice, groupon_agg.has_groupon AS hasGroupon FROM spu s LEFT JOIN sku_agg ON s.id = sku_agg.spu_id LEFT JOIN groupon_agg ON s.id = groupon_agg.spu_id
ORDER BY sku_agg.min_price ASC ORDER BY sku_agg.min_price DESC ORDER BY s.sales DESC ORDER BY s.created_at DESC ORDER BY s.id DESC
